core_flows: Shoot (Camera) or import (Photos) a bird still
AI returns ranked species + oversized field-mark chips on stacked field-cards
Compare silhouettes on the contrast bar; chat (text/speech) to resolve lookalikes
Generate annotated overlay callouts; TTS reads name / tips
Save ID → sighting persists; next ID call reuses confirmed marks/feedback
diversity_key: wingcue birders and casual nature walkers who already photograph birds and need fast mark based id help in the field one handed binoculars up app name wingcue
feature_blocks: Op: Request Camera if needed → capture body/plumage close-up → save via PhotoCaptureService
Result: New IDSession status=draft with photoLocalURL
Empty/deny: Show permission coaching; stay on Field Home
Cancel: Discard draft capture; no session write
ACC-CAM-01: Denied camera still allows Photos import path
